messages:
emily-cs: quick flag - Asterion Health marked our vendor security questionnaire as incomplete and highlighted non-prod data controls as a renewal gating item. they said no docs = procurement hold.

ryan-security: can you paste the exact question they raised?

emily-cs: Q27 from their form:
```
Does your org allow any customer-derived data (including embeddings or model artifacts) in non-production environments? If so, list controls for masking/synthetic substitution, RBAC, key separation, encryption, and retention of access logs.
```

james-devops: tl;dr: we DO NOT keep unmasked PHI in non-prod. we use automated masking pipelines for datasets, synthetic augmentation for model experiments, strict RBAC (okta groups + terraform-managed IAM), non-prod uses separate KMS keys, and access logs go to our SIEM for 180d. i can draft a concise technical response.

emily-cs: customer is mid-renewal (po slated this week). they said this question must be closed before legal approves terms. risk: delay, not churn.

ryan-security: running checklist: 1) confirm masking pipeline artifact and script, 2) export sample audit log (sanitized), 3) access matrix for service accounts and humans, 4) short note on BYOK limitations for hosted vs dedicated/private.

emily-cs: propose: a) 2-paragraph answer for the form b) single-page evidence bundle link c) 20-min walkthrough with Asterion Sec next business day. who owns what?

james-devops: i'll generate the masking-run README, masking script snippet, and export sanitized_access_matrix.csv. will push to evidence bucket and link in confluence.

priya-legal: please don't promise BYOK for hosted customers. i will craft a 1-line legal-approved caveat: "BYOK for non-production environments is only available for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted environments use provider-managed keys with strong separation controls." share before we send.

evidence-bot: Ticket #CS-13109 created by emily-cs: "Asterion vendor form - non-prod evidence + walkthrough" - assignees: james-devops, ryan-security, priya-legal.

james-devops: evidence links (internal): https://confluence.redwood.prod/non-prod-data-controls-2026; https://s3.redwood.internal/evidence/asterion/masking-demo-2026-04-01.tar.gz

ryan-security: i'll add the SIEM retention screenshot and a short bullet list of detection/alerting thresholds.

emily-cs: scheduling note: Asterion Sec suggested Tue 09:00 PST or Wed 16:00 PST. i'm tentatively booking Tue 09:00 PST (20m) and will send calendar once priya okays wording.

priya-legal: reviewing now, will drop a suggested form answer inline. small ask: ensure we don't state retention periods for customer logs that differ from our policy; use "logs retained per our standard retention policy" unless it's already public.

james-devops: uploaded sanitized_access_matrix.csv and masking-readme.pdf to evidence bucket and linked in confluence page.

emily-cs: sending draft to customer after priya signs off. target: close Q27 by EOD Tue so procurement can unblock PO. will update here after send. :thumbsup:

ryan-security: noted. i'll be on the call to answer technical Qs.

emily-cs: resolving this thread for now; will reopen if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
